name: Telluric-Bastion
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a subterranean ocean, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Established during the last boom, the smuggler cache was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
For traders, water, fusion fuel and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
